copy_note: Same task as p14-small-wordtally-v2: spec content, studio cases, extended cases and reference are unchanged; only benchmark_id, these expectations and how the pass bars are checked differ. Owner decision 2026-11-14 (ADR-0105): in-app qualification uses its own frozen version because the p14-small-wordtally-v2 pass bars name a Linux-only script, and frozen pass bars are never reworded.
declared_scale: One module (src/main.py), one builder task, 4 automated checks, 10 frozen studio cases of which 6 are held out, plus 8 extended held-out cases run after the build

expected_requests.note: Each round is one builder and one reviewer request; one repair round adds two

expected_cost_usd: 0.00 on a plan-backed route (plan_roles). Any metered route is out of this packet
one_build_per_attempt: Each attempt is its own product and build in the studio qualification harness, from this spec.json content exactly (no catalog run, selection or spec is created)
qualified_at_declared_scale_when: All 3 attempts meet every pass bar. Fewer is recorded as k of 3 and is not qualified; nothing is re-run to replace a failure
invalid_attempt_when: An infrastructure fault outside the roles (a role request that got no answer, a worker that did not finish a case, a studio restart) stops the attempt before a verdict. It is recorded with its cause, and each attempt may be replaced at most once
pass_bar_per_attempt: Studio build reaches verified_candidate: QA passes every frozen studio case, held-out ones included, in the isolation worker, and the reviewer approves with no findings (the studio's own rule)
Requests used are at most the plan's max_calls (4)
The exported package is verified by the studio: every frozen case re-run on the extracted archive in the isolation worker
All 8 extended cases pass on the exported package, run by the studio in the isolation worker with the studio case rule (exact output and exit status)
measure_and_record: requests used and repair rounds used
wall time from start to verdict
reviewer verdict and the build reason
package manifest SHA-256 and archive SHA-256

known_failure_cases.description: Unicode letters treated as word characters (spec says ASCII only)
Ties ordered by first appearance instead of word order
